name: project-cognition
description: Verified incremental project indexing, dependency-aware task context, and reusable context packs for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Build and reuse a persistent structural index of project files, verify Git and periodic content changes, narrow retrieval with optional FTS5, expand task context with direct dependencies and callers, and cache stable context packs.
capabilities: Incrementally index and verify project files
Detect modifications, deletions, renames, and Git-only changes
Reuse stable task context across sessions
Preserve local project knowledge across rebuilds
interface.defaultPrompt: Build or refresh verified project cognition for the current task, include direct dependencies and callers, then confirm important conclusions against source files.
